alex.name: Alex Morgan
alex.bio: I'm building a wearable navigation prototype that turns nearby obstacles into useful cues. I bring embedded systems and sensor hardware; I'm looking for a computer-vision collaborator to test it beyond the workbench.
alex.networkingGoal: Find a computer-vision collaborator for wearable navigation

maya.name: Maya Chen
maya.bio: I'm building computer-vision models that help people understand what's around them. I'd like to move my visual-assistance demo onto a wearable device and test it with someone who knows embedded hardware.
maya.networkingGoal: Find a hardware collaborator for a visual-assistance wearable

sam.name: Sam Rivera
sam.bio: Making complex tools feel simple. Currently exploring creative collaboration.
